open_unknowns: DBOptions+0x21b (write_dbid_to_manifest per the v8.1.1 header): never stored by the default ctor, never read by any code in the binary; whether it is a real field left unwritten or padding in this build is unresolved
OptionTypeInfo offset for avoid_unnecessary_blocking_io is 0x198, but the ImmutableDBOptions ctor packs avoid at +0x19a (+0x198 is atomic_flush, +0x199 is persist_stats_to_disk)
OptionTypeInfo offset for write_dbid_to_manifest is 0x19a, but the ImmutableDBOptions ctor never reads DBOptions+0x21b and BuildDBOptions does not copy the field at all
